_README: WHO THE SHEETS ARE FOR. Copy this file to `kids.local.json` and put your real
names in it. `kids.local.json` is gitignored; this example is not.
Committed code refers to children by `id` only (kid1, kid2). A real name is read
from kids.local.json at RENDER time and appears solely in the printed Name: field.
That way the interesting part of this repo — the time model, the constraint logic,
the verifier — can be shared without shipping somebody's family with it.
id     stable key used everywhere in code. Do not rename it casually; the drill
plans in drill_gen.py are keyed on it.
name   what prints in the Name: field. The only place it appears.
grade  school grade, used for labelling. The actual difficulty comes from the
`Difficulty pin` section of AGENTS.md, not from this number.
If kids.local.json is missing, the generator falls back to THIS file and prints a
loud notice, so a sheet full of 'Kid One' is never a silent surprise.
